title: Burrow Brawl weapon
description: Data for one weapon. Units: terrain in cells (1 cell = 1 unit), time in seconds, damage in HP (critters start at 100), knockback as an impulse in units/s.

$schema.description: Editor metadata that points at this schema for IDE validation. The game ignores it.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, used in code and saves. Never change once released.

behavior.description: Id of the small behavior script that runs this weapon (e.g. charged-arc, bouncing-throw, rope).

ammo.description: Uses per match per team. null means unlimited.

crateOnly.description: If true, the weapon is only obtained from supply crates, never in the starting arsenal.

endsTurn.description: If true, the turn ends after the weapon resolves (plus the 3s retreat).

windAffected.description: If true, the projectile is pushed by the current wind.

damage.description: Damage at the blast centre or per hit, before falloff.

blastRadius.description: Splash radius in cells. 0 means no area effect.

knockback.description: Knockback impulse at the blast centre, falling off with distance.

params.description: Behavior-specific tuning. Keys are defined by the behavior script named in 'behavior'.

fireable.description: False for sub-munitions (seeds, bombs) that only other weapons spawn. Absent means true.
